teaser.en: A buttressed forest tree with smooth dark bark whose reddish fruits are worth the walk when ripe.
teaser.sw: Mti wa msituni wenye mizizi-ukuta na gome laini jeusi, ambao matunda yake mekundu yanastahili safari ya kuyafuata yakiiva.
teaser.dg: Muhi wa tsakani wenye ngamba na gopha laini dziru, ambao matundage ga kundu, ganaphoivwa, ni ga kuhendzwa hata kure.

summary.en: *Mwawa* is an evergreen tree of the coastal forest, standing on a buttressed base with smooth, dark bark. Its reddish fruit is eaten when ripe.
summary.sw: *Mwawa* ni mti wa kijani mwaka mzima wa misitu ya pwani, unaosimama juu ya mizizi-ukuta na wenye gome laini, jeusi. Matunda yake mekundu huliwa yakiiva.
summary.dg: *Mwawa* ni muhi wa matsaka ga pwani wenye makodza chila wakati; unaima dzulu ya ngamba, na gophare ni laini na dziru. Matundage ga kundu nkuriwa ganaphoivwa.

about.en: *Mwawa* is an evergreen tree whose trunk flares into buttresses at the base. The bark is smooth and dark. It belongs to the cocoa-plum family, and it bears small reddish fruits.
about.sw: *Mwawa* ni mti wa kijani mwaka mzima ambao shina lake hupanuka chini na kuwa mizizi-ukuta. Gome lake ni laini na jeusi. Ni wa familia ya *cocoa-plum* (Chrysobalanaceae), na huzaa matunda madogo mekundu.
about.dg: *Mwawa* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati, na kolore rinatanuka photsi kukala ngamba. Gophare ni laini na dziru. Ni wa jamii ya *Chrysobalanaceae* (jamii ya *cocoa plum*), na unalavya matunda madide ga kundu.

uses.en: The ripe fruit is edible and eaten as a wild snack.
uses.sw: Matunda yaliyoiva huliwa, kama kitafunio cha porini.
uses.dg: Tunda richiivwa nkuriwa, na atu nkurirya weruni dza chakurya chidide.

names.en: The Digo name *mwawa* is recorded in ICRAF's handbook of useful trees, where it appears under a different but related tree, the mobola plum (*Parinari curatellifolia*). The two may share the name, or one may be a mix-up. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded for *Hirtella zanzibarica*.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo *mwawa* limerekodiwa katika kitabu cha ICRAF cha miti yenye manufaa, ambapo linaonekana chini ya mti mwingine tofauti lakini wa jamaa, *mobola plum* (*Parinari curatellifolia*). Huenda miti hiyo miwili inashiriki jina hili, au huenda mmoja ni mchanganyiko wa kimakosa. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa kwa *Hirtella zanzibarica*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo *mwawa* rikaandikpwa kpwenye chitabu cha ICRAF cha mihi ya kufwaida, ambaho rinaphahikana kpwa muhi wanjina ela wa ndugu, *mobola plum* (*Parinari curatellifolia*). Mihi miiri ihi inaweza kukala inashirikiana dzina, au kuna kosa kpwa mwenga wao. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa kpwa *Hirtella zanzibarica*.
